sources.title: GitHub - yinmingjun/TinyBERT
sources.snippet: TinyBERT is 7.5x smaller and 9.4x faster on inference than BERT-base and achieves competitive performances in the tasks of natural language understanding. It performs a novel transformer distillation at both the pre-training and task-specific learning stages.

sources.title: TinyBERT: Distilling BERT for Natural Language Understanding
sources.snippet: Language model pre-training, such as BERT, has significantly improved the performances of many natural language processing tasks. However, pre-trained language models are usually computationally expensive, so it is difficult to efficiently execute them on resource-restricted devices. sources.snippet: TinyBERT is a compressed BERT model that achieves 7.5x size reduction and 9.4x faster inference compared to the original BERT model. This document provides a detailed technical overview of TinyBERT's architecture, training methodology, and implementation details.
